question: Does increasing only the independent observation budget per raw surface from the R6 value of 64 to fixed nested-prefix budgets of 128 and 256 restore exact phase-anchored support invariance across all three aliases of each entity?
hypothesis: R6 fragmentation is finite coverage error rather than a structural failure of the phase-anchored observable: the number of split entity triplets and induced classes will decrease monotonically across 64, 128, and 256 observations per surface, and the 256-observation arm will induce exactly nine correct three-member classes with zero split triplets and zero cross-entity collision pairs.

prior_evidence.observation: The exhaustive and matched controls induced nine intact entity classes. At 64 independent observations per surface, exact anchored supports induced 16 classes, three intact triplets, six split entity triplets, maximum same-entity support symmetric difference 2, and zero cross-entity collision pairs.

scope_statement: This experiment changes exactly one R6 dimension: independent observations per surface. The 64, 128, and 256 arms are nested prefixes of the same frozen per-entity/per-family PRNG streams. Motifs, contexts, phase coordinate, seeds, representation, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain unchanged. It does not add approximate matching, a repair learner, task training, or a language-capability claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

arms_and_inputs.exhaustive_r5_control: Every context_index 0..15 appears once for each of nine entities and three families; exact R5 construction.
arms_and_inputs.r6_64_replication_control: The first 64 observations from each frozen R6 independent sampler stream.
arms_and_inputs.independent_128_arm: The first 128 observations from each same frozen R6 independent sampler stream.
arms_and_inputs.independent_256_arm: The first 256 observations from each same frozen R6 independent sampler stream.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Deterministic support/class cardinality and evaluator-only entity-membership audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_sampled_arms: The exact R6 independent seed formula; budget arms are nested prefixes, so no new or adaptively selected seed is introduced.

representation_and_measurement.surface_selection: The same twenty-seven raw four-byte motifs selected from the frozen R2 matched bridge, occurrence count descending then lexicographic raw key.
representation_and_measurement.signature: Complete sorted set of observed five-byte anchored context tuples; count magnitudes are discarded and equality is exact.
representation_and_measurement.identifiability_audit: For each arm, count induced classes, three-member classes, correct same-entity alias triplets, split entity triplets, and unordered distinct-entity pairs whose surfaces share a class.
representation_and_measurement.sampling_audit: For each sampled budget, count observations and distinct contexts per surface plus maximum symmetric-difference cardinality between same-entity family supports.
representation_and_measurement.semantic_scoring: Entity and family identity enter only after class induction for the audit.

controls: The exhaustive R5 control must reproduce 432 records, sixteen contexts per surface, nine correct three-member classes, zero split triplets, and zero cross-entity collisions.

The 64-observation R6 replication must reproduce 1728 records, maximum same-entity support symmetric difference 2, 16 classes, three correct triplets, six split triplets, and zero cross-entity collisions.
The 128 and 256 arms continue the exact R6 streams; only the prefix length changes.
All arms use the same selected motifs, context formulas, phase coordinate, exact-support representation, class inducer, and evaluator.
Class induction receives no family label, entity label, semantic label, alias dictionary, tokenizer, task transition, external model, approximate matching, distance threshold, or oracle correction.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The exhaustive R5 and 64-observation R6 controls reproduce all frozen exact cardinalities before R7 scientific output is emitted.
Each sampled surface has exactly its arm budget of observations, and 64 and 128 are exact prefixes of the 256 stream.
Sampled context indices, seeds, context formulas, phase coordinate, motifs, and five-byte representation are byte-identical to R6.
Entity and family identity are unavailable to induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
All 36 unordered entity pairs are audited exactly once per arm.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No task training, tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, approximate matching, threshold change, seed search, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.budget_response_supported: Validity and controls pass; split triplets and class counts are nonincreasing from 64 through 128 to 256, and the 256 arm has nine classes, nine correct three-member triplets, zero split triplets, and zero cross-entity collisions.
classification_rules.budget_response_falsified: Validity and controls pass, but the 256 arm retains any split entity triplet or more than nine classes, or either split-triplet count or class count increases with budget.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass; the 256 arm restores all nine triplets but the frozen monotonic conditions fail, or results otherwise satisfy neither supported nor falsified rule.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: The exhaustive R5 or 64-observation R6 replication fails any frozen exact threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, nested-prefix, sampling, representation, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R5/R6 replication, bridge cardinality, nested-prefix construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R7 output begins, complete all four arms and all four 36-pair audits unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not alter samples, seeds, formulas, coordinates, representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacities, or classification after observing R7 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No input formula, phase coordinate, sample budget, seed, representation rule, audit, control, metric, threshold, capacity, or interpretation may change after primary R7 output.
